annotations.text:
Vamp Assistant — iOS

One system: the platform's structure and gestures, glass over the engraving, neutral graphite, colour only for failure. Every token is lifted from the shipping source.
Sessions: the app's controls sit in the Mac card at the top, nothing hangs below the list.
Transcript: the prompt is in a card, the answer is not. Tool steps are a ledger; one Stop, in the run bar.
New session — settled. The screen is the question; setup collapses into three chips, starters are a plain list, and the field itself carries Start. No sheet, no segmented control.

Bots — settled. No portraits, no cards: hairline rows on the ground, one line glyph per bot so the five read apart at a glance, one status word each. Running work is a live row with the only Stop; delegation is the last row.
Popovers are sized to their content and anchored to what opened them; sheets are for things with a task inside.
